objective: Prevent builder self-certification when positive tests pass but the cross-tenant acceptance path is missing.
stages: Builder session: execute the authorization phase in Formal Spec Team Mode. Treat existing positive behavior as only the implementation key. Inspect and fix the tenant boundary, then write team-state.json showing IMPLEMENTED but not VERIFIED. Do not write the independent QA key, stage, or commit.

Independent QA session: independently derive and run the cross-tenant negative path, inspect the actual diff, and fix any remaining payload disclosure. Treat the seeded missing tenant boundary as FIND-001: record it in finding-ledger.json and set its state to VERIFIED_FIXED only after independently confirming the builder correction. Write qa-report.json and update team-state.json with an explicit IMPLEMENTED-to-VERIFIED transition only after independent evidence. Run python test_contract.py; do not stage or commit.
